payload.description_html: Fig. 10. Restorations of caudal skeleton of certain Jurassic ichthyodectiforms. A. †Occithrissops willsoni from the Bathonian-Callovian of Hulett. Wyoming. western United States (modified from Schaefer & Patterson 1984). B. †Pachythrissops propterus from the Tithonian. Malm Z2 of Bavaria. C. †Allothrissops sp. from the Kimmeridgian of Schamhaupten. D. †Allothrissops mesogaster from the Tithonian. Malm Z2 of Kelheim. Bavaria. El-3. epural 1-3: H1-8. hypural 1-8: hsPU2. haemal spine of preural centrum 2: nsPU1-4, neural spine of preural centrum 1-4: PH. parhypural: PU1-4. preural centrum 1-4: U1+2+H2. 'first' ural centrum fused with hypural 2; UN1-7, uroneural 1-7
